comparison.objective: Manipulate sticks in a pick-up-sticks game while avoiding disturbance; unlike adjusting and locking a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Likely selective grasping and extraction of slender, mutually contacting objects, versus hex-key alignment, collar turning, counterholding, and torque-limited locking. Body and specs are absent.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies successful stick removal with limited movement of other sticks; no disturbance threshold, sequence, scoring, or damage rubric is available. Candidate uses explicit dynamic-stop and lock-drift conditions.
comparison.reason: Contact-sensitive object extraction is meaningfully different from iterative damping adjustment, even though both require fine force control.
